integrity: The complete weight enumerator and the exact residue-class multiplicities are supported by a self-contained proof and reproducible finite checks. Numerical searches alone are not treated as an infinite proof. Priority risk remains for unindexed exact enumerations.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary wheels with at least seven rim vertices only; labeled subset counts, no dihedral quotient or missing-spoke extension. Scalar wheel metric dimension and gap feasibility are prior results.
title: Exact resolving-set and metric-basis enumerators of wheel graphs
